races.display_title: Sedgefield Racecourse For Outdoor Events Handicap Chase
races.verdict: TREATY BOY capitalised on his much reduced mark at Kelso 10 days ago and remaining well treated on old form from 9 lb higher, Stuart Coltherd's 9-y-o looks to have an excellent chance of following up. He gets the nod over Prospect House , who possibly found Hexham coming too soon last time so can get back on track. Applejack Poet looks best of the rest. TREATY BOY (IRE) PROSPECT HOUSE (IRE) APPLEJACK POET (IRE)

races.verdict: OPPENHEIMER became an umpteenth winning stable-switcher for this yard at Southwell on Saturday and despite a tricky-looking stall, he's fancied to follow up under a 6-lb penalty at the expense of Sonbelievable , who has made a solid start to life in handicaps. Barry The Worm is a different beast around here, so he's another expected to be in the shake-up. OPPENHEIMER (IRE) SONBELIEVABLE BARRY THE WORM

races.display_title: Group Discounts For Winter Festival General Admission Rated Hurdle
races.verdict: SAGEBOROUGH took a step back in the right direction when fourth of 17 in the Welsh Champion Hurdle at Chepstow on his latest outing and with the step up to 2½m appealing as a potential avenue for improvement, he shades the verdict at the weights. Generous Risk is feared most if bouncing back on his return to action for a yard which has an excellent record in this race, while Quinta Do Lago also merits respect given he remains unexposed at the trip. SAGEBOROUGH (FR) GENEROUS RISK (FR) QUINTA DO LAGO (FR)
